items.question: Is an annual physical covered by insurance?
items.answer: Most plans cover one preventive visit a year at no cost. We check your plan before you book.

items.question: Do I need to fast?
items.answer: Only if bloodwork is planned. Your reminder text will say if you should skip breakfast.
